v2.query: How is Wikipedia segmented into the basic passage retrieval units used by DPR?
v2.rewritten_query: DPR passage retrieval units Wikipedia segmentation passages chunks
v2.hypothetical_document: For dense passage retrieval, Wikipedia articles are typically divided into fixed-length, overlapping text chunks that serve as the basic passage units. This segmentation splits each article into shorter passages so retrieval models can match a query against passage-level representations rather than entire documents.
